title: Coordenador(a) de Produto Jr.
description:
O timaço Conquer é composto por profissionais que desde o primeiro momento foram escolhidos a dedo! Todos com o mesmo sonho, que é revolucionar a educação formando os profissionais que fazem a diferença no país . E sabe como isso é possível? Vivenciando nossos valores dia a dia: Com autorresponsabilidade, tamo junto e inovação, constantemente.

Oferecemos um ambiente completamente colaborativo (aqui é #tamojunto mesmo) e com muitos desafios, o que promove um aprendizado e crescimento contínuo. #LonglifeLearning

Por aqui, valorizamos muito todos os perfis e nossas oportunidades são para todos. Buscamos profissionais que realmente queiram fazer acontecer, proporcionando sempre a melhor experiência aos nossos alunos!

Seu dia típico de trabalho incluirá:

  • Gestão do time de produto com olhar estratégico, priorizando a alta performance, garantindo as entregas da área e prezando pela cultura da empresa e eficiência na liderança que engaja e desenvolve pessoas;
  • Planejar e gerir as estratégias da área de Produto tendo como base pesquisa de mercado, olhar centrado no aluno e a estratégia da empresa;
  • Conduzir o planejamento e a execução de projetos com conhecimento e experiência consolidados nos pilares da conquer: metodologia, conteúdo e professores, com senso crítico para avaliar a qualidade e tom de voz de cada material produzido;
  • Capacidade para tomar decisões baseadas em dados que estejam de acordo com a estratégia do negócio e da empresa;
  • Abertura total para oportunidades novas e de ajuste de rota, prezando pela imagem da empresa, bem-estar dos colaboradores e saudabilidade do negócio;
  • Buscar e manter o relacionamento com demais áreas e parceiros estratégicos da Conquer;
  • Proatividade e autonomia para resolver conflitos e realizar conversas difíceis com o próprio time, com os pares e demais áreas dentro da empresa;
  • Responsável por tomadas de decisão e proposta de processos da área e projetos, garantindo o alinhamento com a gerente da área, prezando pela qualidade e constante comunicação;
  • Ter criatividade e inovação como fortes pilares para o desenvolvimento de produtos educacionais.

O que você precisa ter:

  • Experiência em gestão de pessoas;
  • Experiência em gestão de projetos;
  • Experiência na área de educação de adultos.

O que você pode esperar de nós:

Autonomia para realizar seu trabalho e atingir resultados, colaboração entre times, crescimento acelerado e a possibilidade de impactar a vida de muitas pessoas através da educação. Nosso plano de carreira está atrelado ao seu desempenho e para auxiliar nesse processo, temos uma cultura de feedback.

Além disso é claro, oferecemos:

  • Para você pedir aquele almoço ou fazer compras, pode escolher entre Vale Refeição ou Alimentação
  • Saúde é #paposério, então bora se cuidar. E para isso, oferecemos: Plano de Saúde (com inclusão de dependentes). ????️
  • Plano Odontológico para deixar esse sorrisão ainda mais bonito. ????
  • Alguém disse Seguro de Vida?! Sim, nós temos!
  • Em ritmo de festa, no mês do seu aniversário você tem direito a um Day Off, bom demais né?!
  • Trabalhe de onde quiser! Adotamos o regime remoto e você recebe auxílio para o home office e auxilio equipamento!
  • Para você não ter mais desculpas para deixar a academia de lado oferecemos o Gympass ️️

Apos o período de experiência valorizando seu desenvolvimento.

  • Após 3 meses de experiência você terá cesso gratuito a plataforma Wise Up Online e Conquer Plus, além de descontos na BuzzEditora,meuSucesso.com e nas Pós-graduações da Conquer. Tudo para você desenvolver suas habilidades profissionais!

Valorizamos demais a pluralidade, em todos os seus aspectos, trabalhamos com a convicção de que ela nos possibilita criar vínculos com pessoas incríveis, tornando assim nosso dia a dia Conquer ainda melhor. Queremos estabelecer conexões duradouras independentemente das diferenças.

Você também compartilha desse ideal? Nossas vagas estão abertas para todas as pessoas, sempre dando espaço a diversidade e inclusão. Queremos te conhecer! Então se candidata aí!

  • Step 2: Bora tomar um cafezinho com Talent?! 2 Bora tomar um cafezinho com Talent?!
  • Step 4: Hora de conhecer a líderança! 4 Hora de conhecer a líderança!
  • Step 5: Chegou a proposta #guentacoração! 5 Chegou a proposta #guentacoração!

Não seja quadrado. Seja triângulo.

Se você ainda não conhece a gente, se liga na nossa história: a Conquer Business School nasceu da nossa insatisfação com as instituições tradicionais, que focam muito na parte teórica e não ensinam as habilidades práticas que realmente fazem a diferença na sua vida.

Se você é gente como a gente e também acha que não se encaixa nos padrões das empresas quadradas por aí, veio ao lugar certo!

Nossa missão é revolucionar a educação formando os profissionais que fazem a diferença no Brasil , ajudando nossos alunos e empresas parceiras no desenvolvimento das habilidades fundamentais para todo profissional de alta performance. Em 7 anos de existência, já transformamos a vida e a carreira de mais de 4 milhões de pessoas nas diferentes modalidades: Conquer Plus, Pós-Graduação, MBA, Conquer English e In Company. Quer saber o melhor de tudo isso? Trabalhando com a Conquer, você poderá aproveitar todas elas .

Somos parte do Grupo Wiser Educação!

Nos orgulhamos MUITO disso! A Wiser Educação nasceu da paixão pelo ensino e do desejo de transformar vidas através do conhecimento. Com anos de experiência no mercado, somos hoje um dos maiores grupos educacionais do Brasil.

Entre as marcas que compõem o nosso grupo estão: Wise Up, Wiser Sales Platform, Number One, Power House, Buzz Editora, meuSucesso.com ,BuqMe, Aprova total, Vende-C, Performan-C e MedCof.

Acreditamos que o futuro mais brilhante se constrói com educação. Nosso objetivo principal é gerar valor e transformação na vida de alunos e colaboradores. Por isso, temos como compromisso inspirar e preparar as pessoas para um mundo em constante transformação, promovendo um aprendizado inovador e prático.

Sobre pessoas, para pessoas e feita por pessoas.

Aqui você vai encontrar um time preparado para tudo! Sem medo de errar e sempre buscando novas ideias, a Conquer quer que você se desenvolva e voe alto na carreira.

Então bora encontrar a vaga que você está procurando? Vem voar com a gente!

title: Supervisor de Treinamento Automotivo Pós-Vendas
description:
Job description

Vaga para o time de Pós-Vendas Automotivo.

Buscamos pessoas que assim como a gente, sejam inovadoras, práticas, objetivas, tenham paixão pelo que fazem e visem a excelência. Então, você se encaixa neste perfil?


Main responsibilities

Responsável pela análise das necessidades de treinamento do sistema de serviço pós-venda (manutenção técnica, atendimento ao cliente, gerenciamento de peças, etc.) e desenvolvimento de planos e orçamentos anuais de treinamento.

Estabelecimento de um sistema de currículo de treinamento hierárquico e específico para cada função (integração de novos funcionários, treinamento de certificação técnica, treinamento de certificação de serviço).

Desenvolvimento e implementação de cursos e desenvolvimento de materiais de treinamento pós-venda (incluindo cursos digitais, manuais práticos, bibliotecas de casos), integrando a documentação técnica do OEM e os padrões de serviço da marca.

Coordenação de recursos internos e externos para organizar programas de treinamento online (cursos ao vivo/gravados) e off-line (treinamento no local do revendedor, workshops técnicos).

Projetar mecanismos de avaliação de treinamento (testes teóricos, avaliações práticas, pesquisas de satisfação), acompanhar os resultados de aprimoramento de habilidades dos trainees e gerar relatórios de melhoria.

Construir um banco de dados de registros de treinamento, analisar o ROI (retorno sobre o investimento) do treinamento e otimizar a alocação de recursos.

Colaborar com os departamentos Técnico, de Qualidade e de Relações com o Cliente para alinhar o conteúdo do treinamento com as atualizações de tecnologia do produto e as políticas de serviço pós-venda, garantindo a relevância para as necessidades do negócio.

Gerenciar agências de treinamento externas e recursos de instrutores, garantindo a qualidade da colaboração e o controle de custos.


Requirements and skills

Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia Automotiva, Mecatrônica, Elétrica ou áreas correlatas.

Nível de Inglês Avançado para conversação.

Experiência profissional na área automotiva.

Experiência com gestão de pessoas.

Experiência profissional com treinamentos de produtos automotivos e liderança de projetos.

Conhecimentos em Excel e pacote Office.


Additional information

Aqui na BYD priorizamos o bem-estar de nossos colaboradores e estamos em busca constante de melhorias para o nosso pacote de benefícios. Seu pacote vai contar com:

  • Convênio médico e odontológico coparticipativo para você e seus dependentes;
  • Programas de saúde e bem-estar para a melhoria da sua qualidade de vida;
  • Cartão Golden Farma para compras em farmácias cadastradas com desconto diretamente em folha, valendo tanto para medicamentos como para itens de higiene e beleza;

title: Senior Cloud Solution Architect
description:
Senior Cloud Solution Architect- Automation

Location :

Brazil / Argentina (Remote)

Contract

Job Summary

We are seeking a visionary Automation Senior Cloud Solution Architect to lead the technical design and implementation of this transformative capability. This role is pivotal in architecting a scalable, AI-driven solution that seamlessly integrates advanced data processing, intuitive web interfaces, and intelligent automation.

This position demands a strategic leader who thrives in complexity and is deeply committed to cultivating strong stakeholder relationships. You will play a key role in fostering a culture of innovation and collaboration, guiding cross-functional teams to deliver solutions that drive pricing transparency, operational efficiency, and market competitiveness.

The ideal candidate will bring a unique blend of technical depth and strategic foresight, with a proven track record of leveraging cutting-edge technologies to deliver end-to-end automation at scale. The role with interface with Enterprise Architecture, Business leaders, Senior Leaders and Cyber / Privacy / Legal teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Champion Software Excellence & Talent Development. Promote strong SDLC practices including clean architecture, automated testing, and scalable design. Mentor junior developers through code reviews, technical guidance, and collaborative learning to foster a high-performing engineering culture.
  • Lead Automation use cases architecture using technologies like GenAI, API, D&A, etc, working closely with Product Managers, automation engineers and stakeholders across business and DTS, and Enterprise Architecture.
  • End-to-End Platform Development. Build and maintain front-end (React, TypeScript, Next.Js) and back-end (Python, FastAPI, Node.Js) layers that support GenAI workflows and agentic interactions.
  • API & Agent Framework Integration. Design robust REST and GraphQL APIs for real-time agent communication, tool execution, and memory handling. Integrate frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, and vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma, Weaviate).
  • ETL & Data Pipeline Architecture. Architect and optimize ETL pipelines for real-time and batch data processing. Ensure seamless data flow between GenAI services, databases, and user interfaces.
  • Cloud-Native Deployment & Monitoring. Deploy and scale services using Docker, Kubernetes, and CI / CD pipelines. Apply MLOps best practices for monitoring, versioning, and performance tuning of AI components.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration. Work closely with AI researchers, product managers, and delivery teams to align technical execution with strategic goals. Participate in multi-agent orchestration experiments and rapid prototyping cycles.

Key Qualifications and Experiences

Technical Expertise

Cloud Platform Proficiency

  • Solid experience (minimum 5 years) in architecting, deploying, and managing applications across leading cloud platforms, demonstrating comprehensive knowledge of cloud services including computing, database management, application development, and integration services.
  • Familiarity with cloud-native services (Azure), containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes), and serverless architectures is highly valued.

Embedded Systems and CI / CD

  • Experience with embedded devices, operating systems, and server-client architecture. Proficient in CI / CD and DevSecOps practices.

Architecture Design

  • Experience in Microservices and Event-Driven Architecture. Understanding architecture design principles and patterns. Experience with SQL Server, Web Services (SOAP / REST) and API development.
  • NET Development Skills
  • Extensive hands-on experience in building scalable, high-performance applications using .NET technologies, with strong capabilities in C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET, and Entity Framework. Knowledge of web technologies and frameworks, such as Blazor or ASP.NET MVC, is also crucial.

Integration with SAP and Salesforce

  • Demonstrated ability to integrate .NET applications with both SAP and Salesforce platforms, employing APIs and middleware solutions like SAP Process Orchestration or API to facilitate robust data exchange and streamline workflows across these systems.

Security and Compliance

  • Deep understanding of security practices related to cloud-hosted applications, including implementing secure authentication and authorization mechanisms (e.g., OAuth, OpenID Connect) and ensuring compliance with relevant industry security standards.

Scalability and High Availability

  • Proven expertise in designing applications that are highly scalable and resilient, leveraging cloud scalability features such as load balancing, auto-scaling, and caching services to ensure optimal performance and availability.

Agile Development Practices

  • Strong background in Agile methodologies, adept at managing product backlogs, user stories, sprint planning, and releases, particularly within a cloud-hosted application development environment.

Strategic Problem Solving and Analytical Thinking

  • Ability to address complex technical and integration challenges with a strategic mindset, utilizing analytical and data-driven decision-making to optimize the application's performance and capabilities.

Specialized Skills : Prototyping

  • Ability to engage in rapid prototype development using iterative techniques.

Vendor and Partner Engagement

  • Direct experience managing relationships with outsourcing and consulting partners.

Cloud Architecture Design

  • Deep understanding of cloud solutions and architectures, enabling scalable, flexible, and resilient digital infrastructures that support rapid innovation and development.

Soft Skills and Others

Agile Collaboration

  • Demonstrated experience in effectively working with Agile and Product teams, including involvement with epics, user stories, sprints, and backlog management. The ability to collaborate closely with product owners, engineers, and scrum master’s to foster a productive and agile environment.

Leadership in Communication and Reporting

  • Skilled in leading communication efforts and reporting, adept at preparing and presenting comprehensive updates and reports to senior leaders and stakeholders. Ability to succinctly highlight key metrics, progress, and insights, ensuring transparency and alignment at all levels of the organization.

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Background in coordinating hardware & software development teams and business owners, with the ability to influence SMEs directly.

Job description

Vaga para o time de Pós-Vendas - Divisão Automotiva.

Buscamos pessoas que assim como a gente, sejam inovadoras, práticas, objetivas, tenham paixão pelo que fazem e visem a excelência. Então, você se encaixa neste perfil?

Main responsibilities

Desenvolvimento Estratégico de Serviços: Responsável pela formulação de estratégias abrangentes de serviço, assegurando a otimização contínua dos padrões operacionais e a melhoria dos processos de atendimento.

Soluções Baseadas em Comportamento do Cliente: Dedicar-se à análise dos cenários de uso dos veículos e das necessidades dos clientes, projetando e lançando produtos de serviço alinhados às suas expectativas.

Gestão Integral do Ciclo de Vida do Atendimento: Conduzir o planejamento e a execução de atividades voltadas ao atendimento ao proprietário, abrangendo todas as etapas do ciclo de vida do veículo.

Fortalecimento da Marca e Ações de Marketing de Serviço: Liderar iniciativas de promoção da marca de serviços, incluindo o planejamento e a implementação de campanhas de marketing direcionadas.

Administração de Plataformas Digitais Promocionais: Responsável pela construção, operação e manutenção de plataformas promocionais, como aplicativos automotivos, redes sociais e websites, garantindo sua atualização e otimização contínua.

Melhoria da Experiência do Cliente: Desenvolver medidas voltadas ao aprimoramento da jornada do cliente, promovendo ações de inovação e implementando melhorias constantes.

Formulação de Estratégias de Precificação de Peças: Elaborar estratégias competitivas e sustentáveis para precificação de peças de reposição, com base em pesquisas de mercado e análises comparativas.

Gestão Operacional de Preços e Inteligência de Negócios: Responsável pela administração dos preços de peças de reposição, conduzindo análises de desempenho e propondo ajustes estratégicos para otimização de resultados.

Definição e Revisão de Políticas Comerciais de Pós-Venda: Realizar a formulação, revisão e cálculo das políticas comerciais aplicáveis ao pós-venda, garantindo clareza, precisão e conformidade nos processos financeiros.

Supervisão de Produtos e Acessórios de Pós-Venda: Responsável pela supervisão do desenvolvimento e precificação de produtos e acessórios de pós-venda, assegurando diversidade de portfólio e coerência nos preços praticados.

Gestão de Parcerias Comerciais Estratégicas: Administrar relações comerciais com marcas parceiras, promovendo o fortalecimento das colaborações e contribuindo para a excelência dos serviços prestados.

Requirements and skills

Superior completo em Engenharia, Administração de Empresas, Marketing;

Experiência em formulação de estratégias de serviço ou promoção de marca, com familiaridade com aprimoramento da experiência do cliente e marketing de serviços;

Inglês avançado;

Pacote office avançado.

Additional information

Aqui na BYD priorizamos o bem-estar de nossos colaboradores e estamos em busca constante de melhorias para o nosso pacote de benefícios. Seu pacote vai contar com:

Convênio médico e odontológico coparticipativo para você e seus dependentes;

Programas de saúde e bem-estar para a melhoria da sua qualidade de vida;

title: Head of Sales – SMT
description:
About Us

How many companies can say they’ve been in business for over 177 years?!

Here at ZEISS, we certainly can! As the pioneers of science, ZEISS handles the everchanging environments in a fast-paced world, meeting it with cutting edge of technologies and continuous advancements. ZEISS believes that innovation and technology are the key to a sustainable future and solutions for global change. We have a diverse range of portfolios throughout the ZEISS family in segments like, Industrial Quality & Research, Medical Technology, Consumer Markets and Semiconductor Manufacturing Technology. We are a global company with over 42,000 employees and have over 4,000 in the US and Canada alone! Make a difference, come join the team!

What’s the role?

The Head of Sales is responsible for driving revenue growth for the Semiconductor Manufacturing Technology (SMT) business in the U.S., working in close collaboration with cross-functional teams in Germany and globally. This role focuses on executing sales strategies, identifying and capitalizing on business opportunities, and fostering long-term customer relationships.

The ideal candidate will bring a strong technical background, proven commercial leadership, and a strategic mindset. They will lead a team of sales, finance, and service professionals and work closely with global and regional business units to ensure continued success and growth for ZEISS in the semiconductor market.

Sound Interesting?

Here’s what you’ll do:

  • Provide oversight and leadership for all technical sales activities in the U.S. region.

  • Act as a key support to the Head of SMT, contributing to overall sales strategy and performance.

  • Drive sales activities and manage strategic accounts to meet or exceed annual sales targets.

  • Develop and implement tactical and strategic initiatives aligned with business objectives.

  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities to expand market share and profitability.

  • Cultivate and strengthen customer relationships by managing contract negotiations and profitability assessments.

  • Oversee and continuously improve sales operations, including planning, process optimization, and team development.

  • Effectively communicate the unique value of ZEISS products and services, coordinating with operations and support functions.

  • Deliver impactful technical, sales, and business presentations to internal and external stakeholders.

  • Gather and analyze competitive intelligence and market data to inform strategic decisions.

  • Collaborate with sales and marketing teams to create campaigns that drive awareness and increase product and service sales.

  • Develop and manage global account strategies in coordination with regional teams and global key customers.

  • Represent ZEISS at industry events and conferences, supporting brand visibility and business development.

  • Prepare accurate sales forecasts and pipeline reports aligned with company targets.

  • Foster a high-performance team culture through coaching, development, and performance management.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with finance, marketing, and product management to support customer success and resolve issues.

Do you qualify?

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Organizational Development, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.

  • Minimum of 10 years of successful B2B sales experience within the semiconductor industry or a closely related high-tech field.

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in a leadership role, with demonstrated success managing high-performing teams.

  • Proven track record of driving key opportunities through the sales cycle with detailed, accurate forecasting.

  • Strong consultative, conceptual, and negotiation skills with the ability to develop influential relationships with customers.

  • Demonstrated experience in developing and executing plans to achieve revenue and profitability goals.

  • Results-oriented, disciplined approach to selling with excellent time management and organizational skills.

  • Skilled in managing complex projects and cross-functional teams.

  • Strong understanding of customer business operations, financials, and market dynamics.

  • Ability to effectively communicate technical concepts across various levels of an organization, including technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Excellent interpersonal, problem-solving, analytical, and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to thrive in a competitive and fast-paced environment.

  • Experienced in business reporting, data-driven decision making, and sales analytics.

  • Demonstrated leadership, coaching, and team-building abilities.

  • Ability to influence internal and external stakeholders and work collaboratively in a global matrixed environment.

Compensation

The annual base pay range for this position is $175,000 – $215,000. This role is also eligible for a sales incentive plan.

The pay offered for this role may be influenced by factors such as job location, scope of role, qualifications, education, experience, & complexity/specialization/scarcity of talent. This position is also eligible for a performance bonus or sales commissions. ZEISS also offers robust benefits, including medical plans, retirement savings plan and paid time off.

Sobre a vaga

Procuramos um(a) COO para estruturar e conduzir o "sistema operacional" da empresa, transformar estratégia em execução, eliminar falhas de follow-up entre solicitações e entregas e garantir cadência, métricas e accountability em todas as áreas.

O(a) COO participará das dailys com os gestores de cada área, atuará como elo de comunicação entre times e stakeholders e apresentará mensalmente (em inglês) relatórios executivos consolidados.

Destaques : direito a assistente executivo(a) dedicado(a) e bônus por performance.

Responsabilidades

  • Gestão das operações diárias, garantindo eficiência e alinhamento com a estratégia definida pelo CEO e pelo Conselho.
  • Implementar a visão estratégica em planos de execução operacional com donos, prazos e critérios claros.
  • Supervisionar áreas-chave: desenvolvimento web, desenvolvimento de software, marketing, customer success e suporte.
  • Participar das dailys com os gestores; registrar decisões, prazos, riscos e encaminhamentos.
  • Relatórios operacionais: diários (EOD) com status por área, itens concluídos, tarefa atual + ETA, próximas 3 tarefas (início/fim) e gargalos; semanais e mensais com consolidação de KPIs, riscos, decisões e plano de ação.
  • Mensais em inglês: apresentações executivas a stakeholders com dados consolidados de todos os setores.
  • Apoiar o CFO com dados operacionais para relatórios financeiros e previsões.
  • Reuniões em inglês para contratação de serviços/fornecedores; reuniões com parceiros B2B para coletar feedback e operacionalizar demandas.
  • Gestão de contratações de colaboradores (pipeline, aprovação, integração) e gestão de desempenho (elevar produtividade; desligar quem não performa).
  • Aprimorar processos visando redução de custos, aumento de produtividade e padronização.
  • Gerenciar KPIs (On-time Delivery, Lead Time, Throughput, WIP, Blocker Aging, SLA stage/prod, MTTR, CSAT/NPS), propor ajustes e remover bloqueios.
  • Conformidade e qualidade nos processos; gestão de riscos e planos de contingência.
  • Fomentar inovação em processos, sistemas e práticas de gestão.
  • Assegurar comunicação clara entre áreas e níveis da empresa.
  • Disciplina de ferramentas: Jira (backlog, prazos, status, dashboards) e Confluence (documentação, atas, decisões) como fontes únicas de verdade.

Requisitos

  • 3+ anos como COO (ou função executiva equivalente).
  • 5+ anos de experiência comprovada em Operações.
  • 5+ anos de experiência comprovada em tecnologia e experiência prévia em empresa de software.
  • Conhecimento sólido sobre jogos online (conceitos de latência/lag, jitter, perda de pacotes, impacto na operação e suporte).
  • Domínio prático de Jira e Confluence.
  • Inglês fluente (falado e escrito): dailys, relatórios e apresentações mensais a stakeholders; calls com fornecedores e parceiros.
  • Liderança hands-on, orientação a dados, habilidade de priorizar, cobrar resultados e resolver bloqueios rapidamente.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência profissional no mercado de games.
  • Conhecimento de frameworks de gestão (OKRs, RACI, SLAs).
  • Certificações relevantes (Lean/Six Sigma, PMP, Agile/SAFe).

Sucesso nos 90 dias

  • Dailys com gestores estabelecidas e atas no Confluence.
  • Relatórios diários, semanais e mensais publicados com consistência.
  • Apresentações mensais em inglês bem-sucedidas com stakeholders, com dados consolidados de todos os setores, decisões registradas no Confluence e plano de ação com owners e ETAs.
  • Dashboard no Jira confiável (prazos, status stage/prod, SLAs).
  • Redução visível de atrasos, itens sem dono e falhas de follow-up.

Ambiente & benefícios

  • Trabalho 100% remoto, autonomia e alto impacto.
  • Assistente executivo(a) dedicado(a).
  • Remuneração compatível com mercado + bônus por performance.
  • Cultura de disciplina, colaboração e melhoria contínua.

title: Head of Revenue Operations
description:
Overview

Why should you join dLocal?

dLocal enables the biggest companies in the world to collect payments in 40 countries in emerging markets. Global brands rely on us to increase conversion rates and simplify payment expansion effortlessly. As both a payments processor and a merchant of record where we operate, we make it possible for our merchants to make inroads into the world’s fastest-growing, emerging markets.

By joining us you will be a part of an amazing global team that makes it all happen, in a flexible, remote-first dynamic culture with travel, health and learning benefits, among others. Being a part of dLocal means working with 1000+ teammates from 30+ different nationalities and developing an international career that impacts millions of people’s daily lives. We are builders, we never run from a challenge, we are customer-centric, and if this sounds like you, we know you will thrive in our team.

What’s the opportunity?

As our Head of Revenue Operations, you will build and lead the operating system for profitable growth across dLocal’s global commercial motions. You’ll own forecasting, performance analytics, pricing/fee governance, GTM process and tooling, incentives design, and commercial enablement—partnering with Commercial, Finance, Product, and Operations to drive disciplined execution and continuous improvement.

What you’ll do

  • Develop the end-to-end forecast, reporting, and analytics engine to inform targets, capacity planning, and quarterly business reviews, ensuring consistency and executive-ready “one source of truth”.
  • Govern pricing and fees: review and adjust fee structures, approval workflows, and guardrails; maintain auditable changes and impact tracking across markets and payment methods.
  • Assess, design, and iterate internal incentives and compensation models for Sales/AM/Partnerships to align behaviors to margin, revenue realization, and retention/expansion outcomes.
  • Enhance and scale the sales process and tools (CRM/CPQ, revenue configuration, approval matrices), reducing cycle time and margin leakage while improving quote quality and data completeness.
  • Partner with GTM teams on onboarding, training, and development: playbooks, training, certifications, and role-based enablement that increase ramp speed and win rates.
  • Define and co-drive overall sales strategy with Commercial Leadership, translating strategy into quarterly plans, territories/coverage, goals, and operating cadences.
  • Establish core RevOps KPIs and dashboards (pipeline health, conversion, pricing approval SLAs, discounting/margin, revenue realization) and run insights-to-action cadences with stakeholders.
  • Build and lead a high-performing global Revenue Operations team; create a culture of ownership, measurable outcomes, and cross-functional collaboration with Sales, CS, Marketing, AM, Partnerships, Finance, Product, Legal, and Operations.
  • Partner with Market Intelligence and Sales Ops on pricing proposals, coverage by country/payment method, and “how we win” narratives to support commercial motions.

What you’ll need

  • 6+ years leading Revenue Operations and/or Sales Operations functions, including global scope and multi-stakeholder environments; prior experience leading remote global teams.
  • Proven track record building forecasting, reports, and analytics that influence decisions at the executive level; strong command of BI and data tooling (e.g., Looker or similar).Hands-on experience in pricing/fee governance and approval frameworks across multi-country, multi-product contexts.
  • Experience assessing and implementing incentives and compensation models that align with profitable growth and retention/expansion.
  • Demonstrated process and tooling ownership across CRM/CPQ stacks; ability to translate business requirements into scalable systems and controls.
  • Program leadership across onboarding, learning, and development for GTM teams; ability to design role-based enablement at scale.
  • Strong project management and roadmap ownership; comfortable driving change in fast-paced, high-growth settings.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication; ability to resolve complex problems and trade-offs across Sales, CS, Partnerships, Finance, Legal, Product, and Operations.
  • Fluent in English; other languages are a plus.

Nice to have

  • Fintech or payments domain experience (pay-ins, pay-outs, alternative payment methods, FX).
  • Experience working with Market Intelligence, pricing calculators, or commercial proposal frameworks in global contexts.
  • AI-driven mentality with hands-on experience operationalizing AI/LLMs in go-to-market (GTM) processes and systems.

Skills and tools you may use here

  • CRM/CPQ and revenue tooling (requirements, implementation, and governance)
  • BI and analytics (e.g., Looker or similar), revenue attribution, and profitability analysis
  • Market/pricing intelligence and proposal workflows
  • Enablement platforms and content management for GTM teams

What do we offer?

Besides the tailored benefits we have for each country, dLocal will help you thrive and go that extra mile by offering you:

- Remote work: work from anywhere or one of our offices around the globe!*

- Flexibility: we have flexible schedules and we are driven by performance.

- Fintech industry: work in a dynamic and ever-evolving environment, with plenty to build and boost your creativity.

- Referral bonus program: our internal talents are the best recruiters - refer someone ideal for a role and get rewarded.

- Learning & development: get access to a Premium Coursera subscription.

- Language classes: we provide free English, Spanish, or Portuguese classes.

- Social budget: you\'ll get a monthly budget to chill out with your team (in person or remotely) and deepen your connections!

- dLocal Houses: want to rent a house to spend one week anywhere in the world coworking with your team? We’ve got your back!

*For people based in Montevideo (Uruguay) applying to non-IT roles, 55% monthly attendance to the office is required

What happens after you apply?

Our Talent Acquisition team is invested in creating the best candidate experience possible, so don’t worry, you will definitely hear from us. We will review your CV and keep you posted by email at every step of the process!

Also, you can check out our "webpage","Linkedin","Instagram", and"Youtube" for more about dLocal!

About The Role

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master\'s or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences. This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.

  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model\'s reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

title: Senior Backend & Cloud Infra. Engineer - Python+AWS (LATAM)
description:
Join to apply for the Senior Python Cloud Engineer (LATAM) role at Lateral Group

About The Company

Lateral stands for technology excellence. We’re a profitable, award-winning design and technology company with over 20 years of experience launching bold ventures and transforming businesses. A globally distributed team of 200+ experts united by a shared purpose: the continuous pursuit of quality. Our clients come to us for results, quality and craft - and stay because we keep raising the bar.

What sets us apart isn’t just the talent of our team - it’s the way we work:

  • We Have A Bias For Action & Results. We are doers - we spot the gaps, connect the dots, anticipate what’s around the corner and take action. We move fast, stay focused, and let the results speak for themselves.
  • We Work On Time, On Budget, On Quality - Discipline is our edge - a commitment we make to each other, to our clients, and to the standards we hold ourselves to.
  • We Care Deeply - We care about our work and about each other. Care Is A Competitive Advantage.
  • Every detail matters - Every design, every line of code, every decision. Thoughtful by default.
  • We Do Things Right - Integrity isn’t up for negotiation. We hold the bar high even when no one’s watching.
  • We Keep Improving - Feedback fuels us, we receive it openly, and adapt quickly. Progress over perfection.
  • We’re Obsessed With Agility - We chase momentum by adapting processes to fit problems, not the other way around.
  • We Take Ownership - Everyone leads something here. You will have room to run with ideas and the trust to execute.

What You’ll Do

As a Senior Cloud Python Engineer at Lateral you will:

  • Build and maintain reliable, scalable backend systems with a focus on Python, AWS, and cloud-native infrastructure.
  • Design and implement APIs and batch processing jobs that serve real-world products.
  • Help architect and evolve cloud infrastructure (primarily on AWS) for availability, observability, and cost-efficiency.
  • Write clean, well-tested code that’s easy to understand, easy to debug, and built to last.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including ML and product to ship high-impact features and systems.
  • Automate away repetitive tasks and eliminate bottlenecks with thoughtful scripting and service design.
  • Support infrastructure-as-code efforts and deployment pipelines (Terraform, CDK, etc.).
  • Work closely with senior engineers to make thoughtful trade-offs around performance, reliability, security, and maintainability.
  • Own features from spec to production, with the autonomy and support to do great work.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for backend engineers who love building clean, reliable systems and enjoy solving real problems with real code. You’ll thrive in this role if you bring:

  • 5+ years of experience in backend engineering
  • Strong proficiency in Python for building APIs, services, or batch processing jobs
  • Solid experience with AWS services (e.g. ECS, S3, RDS, SQS, Lambda, etc.)
  • Proficiency in SQL Databases (Postgres)
  • Experience with containerization (Docker, ECS, Kubernetes)
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g. Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK)
  • Strong grasp of software design principles, API development and batch job design and data processing in Python
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and modern deployment practices
  • Comfort owning systems end-to-end: from design to deployment to monitoring
  • A quality mindset - you value clean code, good documentation, and thoughtful testing
  • Clear communication, async collaboration skills, and a proactive approach to problem-solving

Bonus points for

  • Experience with DICOM specific frameworks (PyDICOM, SimpleITK, OsiriX, OHIF, Orthanc)
  • Prior work in performance-sensitive or highly reliable systems
  • Contributions to internal tooling, observability, or deployment automation
  • Familiarity with security best practices for cloud and backend services
  • Experience working with sensitive data, such as PII or PHI, in a regulated industry (e.g., healthcare, finance)

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Real Impact: You’ll work on meaningful products that make a measurable difference - from healthcare and commerce to sustainability and next-gen tech.
  • Remote-First, Office Friendly: Work from wherever you’re most productive. We’re a remote-first company, but you’re welcome to drop in if you’re near an office.
  • An Outstanding Team: Talented, kind, and hard-working people who care deeply about their craft and each other.
  • Growth: You’ll be supported in growing your craft, exploring new paths, and stepping into greater responsibility.
  • A Culture of Excellence: High-quality work delivered sustainably with no burnout or crunch.
  • Variety & Stability: We’re profitable, independent, and over a decade strong with fresh challenges on every project.

This Role Might Not Be for You

We want to respect your time by being clear about what this role isn’t. Skip this opportunity if:

  • You prefer a well-defined hierarchy and fixed roles.
  • Distributed work and async collaboration aren’t your thing.
  • Feedback doesn’t excite you; we value continuous improvement and may provide nitpicky feedback.
  • Change makes you uncomfortable; priorities shift as we scale and mature.

However, if this sounds like fuel, we’d love to talk!

How to apply and what to expect in the interview process

Our hiring process is structured as a sequence of steps. Moving forward is based on how well the previous step goes. We will always:

  • Let you know clearly what the next step is
  • Share updates and feedback wherever possible
  • Invite questions if anything feels unclear

Step 1: Express Your Interest

If this sounds like your kind of team and you’re ready to bring your craft to Lateral, we want to hear from you. Please send us:

  • Your resume
  • A short note about what excites you about this role
  • Links to your work: GitHub/Code snippets, portfolio, architecture/design docs, blog posts, or anything that shows how you think and build

Please don’t include anything sensitive or proprietary. If you’re sharing team projects, let us know what your specific contributions were. We review every application with care. If there’s a fit, we’ll reach out to schedule next steps.

Step 2: Talent Partner Conversation

Purpose: A structured discussion with our People Experience team to delve into your career trajectory, motivations, and alignment with Lateral's values.

  • In-depth questions about your past experiences and decision-making processes.
  • Exploration of your career goals and how they align with the role.
  • Discussion about our company culture, availability, compensation and other logistics
  • Motivators and demotivators.
  • Your life outside coding.

Step 3: Technical interview

Purpose: Assess your technical proficiency and problem-solving abilities.

  • Problem-solving exercises/questions that mirror tasks you'd encounter in the position.
  • Discussions around your approach, reasoning, and solutions.

Step 4: Client interviews

Purpose: Evaluate collaboration, communication, and consultation with external stakeholders.

  • Discussion around business and technical challenges from the client’s perspective.
  • Explain your approach, gather requirements, ask clarifying questions, and articulate tradeoffs.
  • Evaluation of how clearly you communicate solutions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Step 5: Operational interview

Purpose: Understand your approach to prioritizing, collaborating, shipping, and iterating.

  • How you prioritize and break down work.
  • How you collaborate across disciplines.
  • How you handle blockers, feedback, and iteration.

Step 6: Reference Checks

Purpose: We use references to understand patterns, strengths, and context to support you.

  • Provide 2–3 references who have worked closely with you.

Step 7: Offer

If selected, you’ll receive a comprehensive offer detailing compensation and other pertinent information. Our process is thorough and respectful, focusing on mutual fit. We encourage candidates to engage actively and view this as a two-way exploration.

Join us and let’s build something extraordinary.

Seniority level : Mid-Senior level

Employment type : Full-time

Job function : Engineering and Information Technology

Industries : IT Services and IT Consulting

Referrals increase your chances of interviewing at Lateral Group by 2x

Job description

Para atuar no Grupo de Modelagem e Arquitetura de Sistemas Experimentais (MARE) do Laboratório Nacional de Luz Síncrotron (LNLS).

O MARÉ integra a Divisão de Engenharia de Linhas de Luz (DEL) do Sirius, e tem como escopo principal projetar sistemas de instrumentação científica de alto desempenho e/ou complexidade, demandando visão sistêmica, modelagem preditiva e princípios de engenharia de precisão. Os projetos desenvolvidos podem incluir demandas como, nanoposicionamento, otimização de gestão térmica, óptica, vácuo, criogenia, altas temperaturas, pressões e campos magnéticos, bem como tópicos avançados de automação e controle, como os relacionados à sistemas de biocontenção e descontaminação.

Trata-se de um grupo altamente multidisciplinar, que conta com técnicos, especialistas, engenheiros e analistas de formações diversas, integrando ferramentas de engenharia de sistemas, modelagem multifísica, desenhos 3D, e modelos matemáticos para oferecer serviços de engenharia aplicados ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida dos projetos de sistemas experimentais para linhas de luz dos laboratórios Sirius e Orion.

Main responsibilities

  • Elaboração de desenhos conceituais / técnicos, propostas de layouts e projetos de equipamentos de instrumentação científica / estações experimentais para as Linhas de Luz Orion/Sirius em software de modelagem 3D/2D, aplicando GD&T (Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing) quando necessário;
  • Gerar e gerenciar listas de materiais (BOM - Bill of Materials) e documentação técnica (Elaboração e atualização de documentação durante e após o desenvolvimento do projeto, incluindo manuais de montagem e operação, bem como esquemas pneumáticos e hidráulicos);
  • Liberação de desenhos para usinagem e acompanhamento da produção;
  • Prestar suporte técnico à fabricação, montagem e validação dos projetos desenvolvidos;
  • Garantir que todas as alterações e não conformidades sejam incorporadas e documentadas nos desenhos técnicos;
  • Participar de reuniões técnicas com clientes internos e externos, fornecedores e áreas internas (Engenharia, Compras, Produção).

Requirements and skills

  • Formação Superior Completa em Tecnólogo em Mecânica, Engenharia Mecânica, Engenharia Mecatrônica, ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência em projetos de máquinas e equipamentos industriais;
  • Experiência com processos de fabricação (usinagem, soldagem, corte a laser/plasma, eletroerosão, tratamentos térmicos e superficiais);
  • Proficiência nos softwares Autodesk Inventor/SolidWorks (modelagem 3D/2D, chapas metálicas, estruturas soldadas, grandes montagens);
  • Inglês intermediário/ avançado.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em Revit, Tandem ou AutoCAD, incluindo elaboração de plantas baixas integradas a modelos 3D e integração de projetos entre diferentes plataformas;
  • Experiência em simulação por Método dos Elementos Finitos (FEM) utilizando Ansys ou outros softwares;

  • Experiência em metrologia, calibração, montagem e testes;

title: Senior Sales Executive
description:
Overview

Senior Sales Executive at Bitso Brasil. Join to apply for this role and help drive growth in our organization.

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Working At Bitso
We are a diverse team that takes pride in understanding the perspectives of others. We fully embrace working remotely and we are eager to act, improve and accelerate progress inside and outside of our organization. To drive revolutionary changes in society and make crypto useful, we delight our customers with world-class products, deep care, and intentional empathy.

Your Purpose
As a Sales Top Executive, you will be at the forefront of our growth strategy, tasked with winning commercial deals in key markets/verticals. Your role is not just about selling; it\'s about understanding customer pain points, leveraging our unique selling propositions (USP), and developing targeted commercial offers. Success in this role involves collaboration, strategic thinking, and meticulous pipeline management.

Reports To
Head of Sales

Who You Are

  • 10 years of experience in a sales position.
  • +4 years of experience selling remittances, cross-border payment and/or complex payments solutions.
  • Developed and executed comprehensive sales strategies for a full suite of Forex products (e.g., spot, forwards, options, cross-currency swaps) for institutional and corporate clients.
  • Previous sales experience at a financial institution/large brokerage firm.
  • English fluency
  • Proven experience in business development and sales as a hunter.
  • Strong understanding of commercial strategy and pre-sales support
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
  • Experience with CRM tools, preferably Hubspot.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams for seamless customer onboarding.

What You Will Do

  • Engage with potential customers, understand their pain points, and effectively communicate our USP to win new business.
  • Collaborate with Marketing to identify potential customers and provide structured feedback on generated leads.
  • Identify customer pain points and formulate targeted commercial offers to address their specific needs.
  • 360 sales cycle, open and close new business.
  • Document, track, and analyze the sales pipeline using the CRM tool (Hubspot) to ensure a robust and well-managed sales process.
  • Maintain, refresh, and expand the sales funnel, working closely with Sales Ops to track key performance indicators (KPIs) and provide regular updates to Senior Management.
  • Collaborate with various functions (e.g., KYC, Legal, Product) to facilitate a smooth customer onboarding process, ensuring a successful transition to production.
  • Work closely with the Account Manager during onboarding to ensure revenue targets are achieved, and customers have an exceptional experience.

Research in Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion suggests that individuals may hesitate to apply for jobs if they do not meet all the listed criteria. At Bitso, we value diversity and your unique strengths could be just what we\'re looking for. If this role excites you but you don\'t match every point in the description, we still want to hear from you.

Who We Are
With over 9 million users, Bitso is the leading cryptocurrency platform in Latin America. We are developing the cryptocurrency ecosystem in the region and enabling financial inclusion. We believe crypto is the future of finance, and we’re committed to making it useful by providing equal access to safe and intuitive financial products.

When we hire people for our team, we specifically test for the following traits in addition to our cultural values:

  • Mission-Driven: We seek individuals who are passionate about crypto and Bitso’s mission and resilient in facing industry challenges
  • High Sense of Urgency: We prioritize candidates who demonstrate a high sense of urgency and responsibility.
  • Exceptional Hard Skills: We seek individuals who possess exceptional skills in their respective fields, with no room for mediocrity.
  • Self-Management: We look for individuals who can independently manage their work, career, and professional development.

Compensation & Benefits
At Bitso, you are taking the front seat on the edge of crypto innovation, creating the next generation of crypto-powered products. So for those willing to commit, adapt and pioneer the most important change of the century we offer:

  • Me Time program, including unlimited paid time off.
  • Remote-first work environment.
  • Employee Stock Option program.
  • Zero trading fees through our Bitso Alpha app.
  • Extended Family Leave Policy: all birthing parents, non-birthing parents and adopting parents are eligible for a 4-months leave.
  • Premium health, dental and life insurances in Mexico, Gibraltar, Colombia, USA, Brazil and Argentina.
  • Monthly stipend for gym memberships, relaxation activities, sports equipment, cooking classes, books, entertainment and more.

Want to leave an undoubtedly legacy with us? Fasten your seatbelt and join this spaceship, where you will find exponential growth and the opportunity to thrive!

Overview

Client Experience Operations Specialist — Toptal

About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce. We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary

As a member of our Toptal Service Center team, you will work closely with the Director, Client Experience, and the leadership of the Toptal Service Center to ensure we have the data, tools, and workflows needed to operate at our best. You will be responsible for extracting and analyzing data from Tableau, SQL, and Zendesk, creating clear insights and reporting packages for leadership. You will also own and optimize our support systems (Zendesk, Slack, automations), helping to streamline workflows and improve efficiency across the organization. This role is a key enabler of our team’s success, providing both the operational backbone and the analytical insights that drive better decisions.

Our ideal candidate has outstanding discipline, is highly passionate, and is eager to learn, grow, and develop. You will thrive in a fast-paced environment and strive to go above and beyond to effectively resolve clients’ and client services’ inquiries, issues, and concerns while maintaining a high level of client satisfaction. This role is perfect for someone who is passionate about using tools and data to solve problems, automate workflows, and make complex processes simple and scalable.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities

  • Leverage SQL, Zendesk, and Tableau to analyze data and deliver actionable insights and reporting packages for the Customer Support leadership team.
  • Own and optimize Zendesk configuration (queues, triggers, macros, automations) and support tools such as Slack workflows and Zapier integrations to improve efficiency and reduce manual work.
  • Work collaboratively with the team’s managers and cross-functional partners (Product, Engineering, and Operations) to ensure systems and workflows align with business needs.
  • Act with a sense of ownership in identifying process gaps, recommending improvements, and implementing scalable solutions.
  • Maintain process documentation and act as a subject matter expert for tools, data extraction, and reporting practices.
  • Support ad-hoc analysis and operational projects, providing leadership with the insights needed for decision-making.
  • Assist with training and onboarding for team members on tools, workflows, and data processes.

First Week

  • Onboard and integrate into Toptal.
  • Become familiar with the various platforms and systems Toptal utilizes to offer timely and exceptional client support.
  • Complete customized onboarding to navigate through the organization and understand the moving parts that make up the Toptal business model.
  • Rapidly begin learning about Toptal’s history, culture, and vision, with a focus on the state of the talent industry, the Future of Work, and the core messages important to Toptal.

First Month

  • Familiarize yourself with the extensive support materials available to successfully support our clients and talent.
  • Learn the key internal and external stakeholders and how clients can best be served by the different Toptal teams during their lifecycle.
  • Have a solid understanding of the Toptal platform as it relates to clients and the most frequent request processes.
  • Effectively and independently resolve client issues.
  • Gain a comprehensive working knowledge of the client experience from start to finish.

First Three Months

  • Confidently onboard to our support organization, tools, and workflows.
  • Build strong working relationships with the Director and Support Managers.
  • Be comfortable extracting data from Tableau, SQL, and Zendesk to produce accurate weekly and ad-hoc reports.
  • Learn and document our existing Zendesk setup, Slack workflows, and automations.

First Six Months

  • Be recognized as the “go-to” person for data extraction, workflow troubleshooting, and Zendesk admin needs.
  • Independently produce reporting packages and insights that help leadership make decisions.
  • Deliver at least 2–3 workflow or automation improvements that save the team measurable time.
  • Actively document processes and creating clarity around how tools and data are used.
  • Start to contribute ideas for larger process or system enhancements.

First Year

  • Be fully confident operating as the operational backbone of the support organisation while exercising discretion and independent judgment.
  • Anticipate leadership needs by proactively surfacing insights, trends, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Lead small-to-medium operational projects (queue redesign, automation rollouts, feature pilots).
  • Establish clear reporting and automation processes that run smoothly without micromanagement.
  • Be trusted as both a subject matter expert in tools and a partner in shaping how support operates at scale.

Qualifications and Job Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree is required.
  • 3+ years of experience in operations roles.
  • Intermediate SQL proficiency is required. You should be comfortable writing queries to extract and transform data.
  • Strong proficiency with G Suite tools, especially tools for analysis and reporting.
  • Zendesk admin experience, including managing queues, triggers, macros, and dashboard setup, is a strong advantage.
  • Comfortable extracting data from Tableau.
  • Experience with workflow automation tools, such as Zapier and Slack workflows.
  • Collaborative. Exceptional interpersonal skills and the ability to build strong, customer-centric relationships, both internally and externally.
  • Team-oriented. Cooperative and promotes an environment of continuous improvement.
  • Problem solver. Must be capable of uncovering issues and resolving them quickly and effectively.
  • Time management. Must be able to work independently and manage multiple priorities without constant supervision.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
Overview

Job Title: AI Engineer (Search Engine)

About the Company: Insight Global's Client

Type: 10 month extending contract

Compensation: Shared upon initial WhatsApp screening call

Location: Fully Remote

Working Hours: 10AM - 6PM BRT (9AM-5PM EST)

Interview Process: immediate interviews available - 2 rounds can close by end of next week.

Responsibilities

  • Join a small, focused team building backend features for an existing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) service.
  • Build and optimize RAG models for search across large-scale medical and scientific documents, including pre-processing and embedding over half a billion documents to ensure they are searchable and contextually accurate.
  • Develop semantic chunking strategies, improve the automated evaluation pipeline, and fine-tune LLMs for textual RAG use cases.
  • Perform hands-on experimentation, model development, and backend engineering, with deployments to non-prod environments and collaboration with DevOps for production rollout.
  • Collaborate with the team to ensure clear updates and effective communication while working as an individual contributor.

Qualifications

  • Requirements: Ability to work full-time hours on a contract basis (10AM - 6PM BRT)
  • Strong communication skills
  • CLT ONLY (This cannot change to PJ)
  • No health benefits provided in CLT benefits
  • Needs to be able to start within 2-3 weeks
  • Paid on a monthly basis, no overtime

Must-Haves

  • 1+ years of experience as a Search Engineer or AI Engineer
  • Search Technology Experience – OpenSearch, building scalable search systems
  • 2+ years of Python development experience, including API creation, model training, testing, and general backend programming
  • Familiarity with LangChain for building LLM workflows using tools, memory, and retrieval
  • Strong communication skills – able to work independently while providing clear updates to the team

Nice to Have Skills

  • Familiarity with AWS infrastructure (IAM, VPC, S3, etc.)
  • Exposure to RAG architectures, specifically textual RAG use cases

Project Overview

We are hiring one AI / LLM Engineer (1 Mid-Level) to join a small, focused team building backend features for an existing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) service. Your primary focus will be building and optimizing RAG models for search across large-scale medical and scientific documents, including pre-processing and embedding over half a billion documents to ensure they are searchable and contextually accurate. You’ll work on semantic chunking strategies, improving the automated evaluation pipeline, and fine-tuning LLMs for textual RAG use cases. The role involves hands-on experimentation, model development, and backend engineering, with deployments to non-prod environments and collaboration with DevOps for production rollout. While this is a heads-down, individual contributor role, strong communication and collaboration with the team are essential.

Overview

Why should you join dLocal?

dLocal enables the biggest companies in the world to collect payments in 40 countries in emerging markets. You’ll play a key role in managing cash flow, optimizing working capital, and supporting our broader financial goals.

What will I be doing?

  • Execute and monitor daily treasury operations, including cash positioning, funding, and investments;

  • Develop and maintain cash flow forecasts and liquidity reports;
  • Support the implementation of cash management and working capital strategies;
  • Analyze financial reserves and investment opportunities, in line with internal policies;
  • Prepare treasury reports and dashboards for senior management;
  • Identify and mitigate financial risks, including liquidity, credit, and market risks;
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Finance, Product, Risk, Compliance) to optimize financial flows and support new initiatives;
  • Assist in automating and improving treasury processes and reporting tools;
  • Maintain strong working relationships with banks and financial institutions.

What skills do I need?

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting , or a related field;
  • Solid experience in corporate treasury , cash management , and short-term investments ;
  • Previous experience in fintechs , payment institutions , or payment facilitators is required ;
  • Strong understanding of financial instruments , receivables anticipation , and risk management ;
  • Advanced analytical skills and ability to interpret large financial datasets;
  • Proficiency in treasury systems and financial reporting tools;
  • Strong skills in Excel and experience with Python and BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, etc.);
  • Fluent in English ; Spanish is a plus;
  • Self-starter with strong attention to detail, organization, and accountability.

What do we offer?

Besides the tailored benefits we have for each country, dLocal will help you thrive and go that extra mile by offering you:

  • Remote work: work from anywhere or one of our offices around the globe!*
  • Flexibility: we have flexible schedules and we are driven by performance.
  • Fintech industry: work in a dynamic and ever-evolving environment, with plenty to build and boost your creativity.
  • Referral bonus program: our internal talents are the best recruiters - refer someone ideal for a role and get rewarded.
  • Learning & development: get access to a Premium Coursera subscription.
  • Language classes: we provide free English, Spanish, or Portuguese classes.
  • Social budget: you\'ll get a monthly budget to chill out with your team (in person or remotely) and deepen your connections!
  • dLocal Houses: want to rent a house to spend one week anywhere in the world coworking with your team? We’ve got your back!
  • *For people based in Montevideo (Uruguay) applying to non-IT roles, 55% monthly attendance to the office is required

What happens after you apply?

Our Talent Acquisition team is invested in creating the best candidate experience possible, so don’t worry, you will definitely hear from us. We will review your CV and keep you posted by email at every step of the process!

You can also check out our webpage, but as per formatting rules, links are kept text-only in this refinement and you can follow us on LinkedIn, Instagram, and YouTube for more about dLocal.

  • Team Play : Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

Você fará parte do time de tecnologia responsável pelo desenvolvimento de ferramentas de backoffice que atendem mais de 2000 operadores. O principal desafio do time é construir e manter aplicações de gestão de recursos, garantindo alta eficiência operacional e excelência nos resultados entregues aos clientes. O trabalho envolve decisões técnicas relevantes, com impacto de médio e longo prazo, especialmente em problemas relacionados à gestão da Conta Stone e automação de fluxos. O ambiente é dinâmico, inovador e distribuído, com forte cultura remote-first e foco em entregar produtos de alta qualidade para transformar a experiência dos lojistas na gestão de seus negócios financeiros.

  • Experiência com Git e GitHub.

title: Data Architect / Data Engineer
description:
Overview

About Us

At Aravita, we're not just building a product; we're building the future of AI-enabled fresh food operations. We are a fast-paced, innovative startup on a mission to solve complex problems with data. Our culture is built on collaboration, curiosity, and a passion for technology. We're looking for a brilliant Data Engineer / Cloud Architect to join our dynamic team and help us build a scalable, world-class data infrastructure.

The Role

As a Data Engineer / Cloud Architect, you will be at the heart of our data operations. You'll design, build, and maintain our cutting-edge data platform, empowering our entire organization to make data-driven decisions. This is a hands-on role where you will architect robust data pipelines, optimize our cloud environment, and ensure our data is secure, reliable, and accessible.

Your primary responsibilities

  • Designing, developing, and deploying scalable ETL / ELT pipelines using Azure Data Factory and PySpark.
  • Architecting and managing our Databricks environment, leveraging Unity Catalog to build a state-of-the-art Lakehouse architecture.
  • Implementing and managing infrastructure on container orchestration platforms like Kubernetes.
  • Developing monitoring and observability solutions using tools like Grafana to ensure system health and performance.
  • Collaborating with data scientists, analysts, and software engineers to understand data needs and deliver effective solutions.
  • Championing best practices in data governance, data quality, and cloud security.

What You\'ll Bring

We\'re looking for a seasoned expert with a passion for building great things. You should be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and have a strong foundation in data engineering and cloud principles.

Key Qualifications

  • Proven experience as a Data Engineer, Cloud Architect, or a similar role.
  • Strong proficiency in building data pipelines with Azure Data Factory and processing large-scale data with PySpark.
  • Deep, hands-on experience with the Databricks platform, including a strong understanding of Unity Catalog and the principles of Lakehouse architecture.
  • Solid experience with containerization and orchestration using Kubernetes.
  • Familiarity with monitoring and visualization tools, specifically Grafana.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently.
  • Must currently reside in Brazil. Preference will be given to candidates in the greater São Paulo area to facilitate occasional team meetups.

Why You\'ll Love Working With Us

We believe that our team is our greatest asset, and we invest in our people accordingly. When you join us, you can expect :

  • Competitive Compensation: An attractive salary and benefits package.
  • Remote-First Culture: The flexibility to work from anywhere in Brazil, with the technology and support you need to succeed.
  • Amazing Startup Environment: A vibrant, inclusive, and collaborative culture where your ideas are valued and your impact is real.
  • Growth Opportunities: The chance to grow your skills and career in a rapidly expanding company.
  • Meaningful Work: The opportunity to work on challenging projects that have a direct impact on our business and customers.

If you are a data visionary ready to make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you!

Job description

Quer revolucionar a construção civil com a gente?

Então vem pro Time Tecverde!

Aqui na Tecverde todas nossas vagas são inclusivas para PcD, pessoas pretas e pardas e pessoas LGBTQIAP+.

Se essa vaga não é para você, não tem problema, fique por dentro das vagas no nosso site e do nosso banco de talentos!

Main responsibilities

O Gerente de Engenharia será responsável por liderar o desenvolvimento dos projetos executivos dos empreendimentos, garantindo qualidade técnica, aderência aos prazos, compatibilização entre disciplinas e integração com as áreas de obra e fábrica. Terá sob sua responsabilidade a gestão das equipes de projetistas internos e externos, atuando como elo entre Engenharia, Produção, Suprimentos, Obras e Produto. Será responsável por assegurar a viabilidade técnica e produtiva dos projetos dentro da lógica da construção industrializada.

Principais responsabilidades:

  1. Gestão de Projetos Executivos
    • Coordenar o desenvolvimento dos projetos executivos das disciplinas de arquitetura, estruturas, hidráulica, elétrica, fundações, compatibilização, entre outras.
    • Garantir que os projetos estejam aderentes às premissas do produto, aos padrões técnicos da empresa e às normas vigentes.
    • Realizar a compatibilização entre disciplinas visando a redução de retrabalhos e a eficiência construtiva.
    • Assegurar a liberação tempestiva dos projetos conforme os marcos dos cronogramas de produção fabril e execução de obra.
    • Acompanhar o ciclo completo do projeto, desde o anteprojeto até o as built .
  2. Interface com Áreas-Chave
    • Atuar em estreita colaboração com as áreas de Obra, Fábrica, Produto, Suprimentos e Qualidade, promovendo a integração técnica entre os projetos e a execução.
    • Antecipar demandas e riscos junto à obra e à fábrica, propondo soluções de engenharia que atendam às restrições operacionais e produtivas.
    • Suportar tecnicamente a equipe de compras na especificação de materiais e contratação de fornecedores/projetistas terceiros.
    • Participar de comitês de viabilidade técnica de novos produtos ou tipologias, propondo soluções eficientes e padronizadas.
  3. Gestão de Equipes
    • Liderar as equipes internas de projetistas, arquitetos e engenheiros, além de gerenciar os escritórios terceirizados contratados para desenvolvimento de projetos.
    • Distribuir e priorizar demandas entre os times, garantindo alinhamento com os cronogramas e diretrizes corporativas.
    • Estabelecer e acompanhar metas e KPIs de produtividade, qualidade e cumprimento de prazos da equipe de projetos.
    • Promover o desenvolvimento técnico do time, fomentando a cultura de melhoria contínua e inovação.
  4. Processos, Qualidade e Inovação
    • Garantir a aplicação de boas práticas de gestão de projetos e processos de revisão e validação técnica (revisões internas, checklists, validações de obra e fábrica).
    • Manter atualizada a biblioteca de soluções técnicas e boas práticas da empresa, com foco em padronização e escalabilidade.
    • Atuar na melhoria contínua dos processos de desenvolvimento de projetos, buscando eficiência, digitalização e redução de erros.
    • Apoiar a implantação e uso de ferramentas BIM, PLM, bibliotecas paramétricas e outras tecnologias associadas à industrialização da construção.
  5. Relacionamento com a Diretoria
    • Reportar diretamente à Diretoria Técnica e/ou Diretoria de Engenharia.
    • Apresentar relatórios de avanço dos projetos, gargalos, riscos e proposições de melhoria.
    • Participar de fóruns estratégicos da companhia, contribuindo com visão técnica para tomada de decisões corporativas.
    • Atuar com postura de dono, buscando o alinhamento entre viabilidade técnica, custos, prazo e qualidade.

Requirements and skills

  • Formação superior em Arquitetura, Engenharia Civil ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Projetos, BIM Management, Construção Civil ou áreas afins (desejável).
  • Experiência consolidada na coordenação de projetos executivos em empresas de construção civil, incorporação ou construção off-site/modular.
  • Experiência com gestão de equipes internas e escritórios terceirizados.
  • Domínio de ferramentas de projetos (AutoCAD, Revit, Navisworks, BIM 360, Excel, MS Project, etc.).
  • Conhecimento de normas técnicas, processos de aprovação junto a órgãos públicos e práticas de compatibilização.
  • Perfil proativo, com boa capacidade de organização, visão sistêmica, liderança e comunicação.

A área de Business Analytics tem como propósito resolver problemas de negócio complexos; em outras palavras, a equipe de Business Analytics utiliza técnicas de estatística, algoritmos, e métodos estocásticos para modelar dados internos e externos para gerar informações valiosas que possam conduzir ações de melhoria de negócios.

O machine learning engineer sênior atuará na equipe de business analytics e será responsável por produtizar soluções de modelagens, aprendizado de máquina e modelos matemáticos em ambientes de nuvem ou interno, além de monitorar a qualidade dos modelos em produção.   • Experiência comprovada de 4 anos na área de MLOPs;
  • Conhecimento de Cloud em AWS/Azure - Experiência com tecnologia de containers em cloud (AWS ECS/EKS, ECR, e/ou Azure AKS), Arquitetura Serverless (AWS Api Gateway, AWS Lambda e/ou Azure Functions);

  • Conhecimento em Kubernetes;

Nossa gestão sólida, aliada à inovação, nos posiciona como referência global no setor alimentício.

Na Minerva Foods, a tecnologia desempenha um papel estratégico na evolução dos nossos processos e na construção de soluções inovadoras. Investimos continuamente em transformação digital, segurança da informação e automação para garantir a eficiência operacional e impulsionar a sustentabilidade em toda a nossa cadeia produtiva.

Conecte-se a esse propósito

Se você busca desafios e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que transforma dados em insights, aprimora a infraestrutura tecnológica e desenvolve soluções inovadoras para a indústria alimentícia, a Minerva Foods é o lugar certo para você. Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de trabalhar com projetos estratégicos, tecnologias de ponta e um time colaborativo que impulsiona a inovação.

Venha fazer parte da equipe de tecnologia da Minerva Foods e ajude a moldar o futuro da indústria com soluções que fazem a diferença.
